TAL_BERSERKER_SAVAGE.why: A melee or thrown weapon hit (or an Unarmed Strike) that reduces a creature of CR at least half your CL to 0 HP opens a Bonus Action to regain Martial Focus for the rest of the turn (combat/ext/savage_focus.py); a creature with no tracked Cultivation Level counts, with a GM rider to confirm its CR.

TAL_WRESTLING_TACKLE.why: After the Dash action, a Bonus Action Grapple attempt on a creature within reach: the Unarmed Strike Grapple option as a Bonus Action offered only in a turn with the Dash (combat/ext/wrestling_tackle.py).

foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.oath_ski.why: Oath-Skin Frame is a passive maximum-HP increase (PB, another PB when Integrated): the sheet's hit points already carry it from creation (non_sphere_authority/foundation_mechanics.py hp_maximum_modifiers), as for Tyrant-Blood Frame.

foundation.red_lotus_ash_returning_v0_2B.why: Ash-Returning Meridian's maximum-HP increase of PB is already in the sheet's hit points from creation (non_sphere_authority/foundation_mechanics.py hp_maximum_modifiers); it grants no resource and no per-round tracking, and which Fire/Ash/Blood methods count as Foundation-aligned is the GM's.
